summary: The filing is a Form 6-K containing a news release about final 2025 assay results from NexGen Energy Ltd.'s Patterson Corridor East uranium discovery. It reports high-grade uranium intercepts confirming expansion and continuity of a high-grade subdomain, and a new subdomain at depth. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation transactions. The filing is a routine operational update on exploration drilling results and is not a special situation as defined.
